question: Should OpenClaw adopt this shared localization package and its new gateway command, plugin/skill presentation, and approval-rendering contracts as the long-term cross-product API after the prerequisite localization PRs land?
rationale: This is a broad product and compatibility decision spanning protocol, plugins, channels, CLI, TUI, and Control UI; the draft and linked RFC establish a proposal but do not show a maintainer decision in the provided discussion.

options.title: Approve the stack contract after prerequisite review
options.body: Review the five PRs in the declared order, explicitly accept the gateway and metadata contract, then rebase this slice onto the landed foundation.

options.title: Narrow this slice to internal adoption
options.body: Keep localization helpers internal and defer public gateway or plugin metadata additions to a separately approved compatibility proposal.

options.title: Pause the series
options.body: Defer the cross-product localization architecture until maintainers choose the supported scope and ownership model.

recommendation.title: Approve the stack contract after prerequisite review
recommendation.body: Review the five PRs in the declared order, explicitly accept the gateway and metadata contract, then rebase this slice onto the landed foundation.

likelyOwner.reason: The series author is the best available routing contact for the intended boundary and RFC rationale; final approval remains a maintainer decision.
